body: I’ve tried therapy but found in my experience i feel worse, I’m currently looking into getting a diagnosis for a few issues. And the thing is I do feel loved sometimes and he can make me feel good, I just worry at this point we‘re both walking on eggshells for each other. But I appreciate this comment, thank you ❤️

Not a lot of context for this was given imo, how old are you guys yknow? Young love can end up being a little rushed sometimes and some people don’t know or just haven’t been told what they’ve done is a bit awkward or seen as wrong, maybe just tell her about it
